options.description: The router hover and focus come from.
options.name: input

options.description: What it says. Wraps at `maxWidth`. An empty string says nothing, and a bubble with nothing to say is hidden rather than drawn as an empty box, until `setText()` gives it words again.
options.name: text

options.description: The part of the anchor the bubble points at, when that is not the whole of it: a rectangle in cells, relative to the anchor's top-left corner, or `undefined` where there is nothing in the anchor to point at, which hides the bubble while keeping it. Defaults to the whole anchor.
options.name: area

options.description: Draw the border with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says, which is the rule `note()` and the modal keep.
options.name: ascii

options.description: How long the anchor has to be hovered or focused before the bubble shows, in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.
options.name: delay

options.description: A third reason to show the bubble, beside the pointer and the focus: shown while it returns `true`, with neither. Asked in the effect that reads the focus, so a signal it reads shows or hides the bubble the moment it is set. `delay` still applies. While it returns `true`, Escape and `hide()` do nothing: the app asked for the bubble to stay. That is how a line chart's pinned sample keeps its readout once the focus has gone. Defaults to none.
options.name: hold

options.description: The widest the bubble may be, border included, in cells. Defaults to 40.
options.name: maxWidth

options.description: The bubble's own props: a class. Geometry is the tooltip's, and is overwritten.
options.name: props

options.description: Whether `--quiet` hides it. Defaults to following the process-wide request.
options.name: quiet

options.description: The side it goes on when there is room. Defaults to `bottom`.
options.name: side

api.signature: function attachTooltip(anchor: Element, opts: TooltipOptions): TooltipHandle

registryDescription: A tooltip: text anchored to an element, shown on hover or focus, flipped to stay on screen
